title: Winter Clothes Distribution 2026
description: Providing warm clothes and blankets to underprivileged families and floating people in northern Dhaka.

title: Clean City, Green Dhaka Drive
description: Massive community cleanliness drive covering major roads, separating plastic waste and placing bins.

title: Free Community Health & Eye Camp
description: General physician consultation, eye checkups, blood sugar screening and basic medicines for street children and seniors.

title: Primary School Book Donation Fair
description: Distributing textbooks, notebooks, school bags and stationery kits among underprivileged elementary students.

title: Emergency Blood Donation Campaign
description: Voluntary blood typing and donation drive to support emergency patients and local public hospitals.

title: Urban Tree Plantation Movement
description: Planting fruit-bearing and shade trees along school perimeters and neighborhood parks to combat urban heat.

title: Food Rescue & Slum Meal Sharing
description: Collecting surplus banquet food and distributing freshly packed hygienic meals to impoverished families.

title: Stray Animal Care & Vaccination Day
description: Providing rabies vaccines, minor medical dressing, and food supplies to stray dogs and cats across the neighborhood.

title: Elderly Care Home Visit & Recreational Eve
description: Spending quality time, playing indoor games, sharing warm snacks and musical sessions with elderly shelter residents.
